description: Pins the documented known limitation (architecture section 4.3): the user's last input in Figma is at 10:00. At 12:00, before the 5-minute threshold is reached, Blender steals focus. Retroactive idle relabelling only reaches back within the open interval, so Figma's interval closes at 12:00 as active (2 minutes of idleness credited as active, bounded by one threshold). Blender opens active at 12:00 and is relabelled idle in place at 15:00, because idleness began before it opened. Input at 20:00 starts a new active interval.
